content:
nothing sells if you are too shy to sell it.

be shameless about your price. you know what your work is worth.

be shameless about pitching. you do not have to wait to be asked.

be shameless about your wins. if you did the work, talk about it.

be shameless about reposting your offer. not everyone saw it the first time.

be shameless about following up. silence is not always a no.

be shameless about asking for a referral. if they loved working with you, ask.

be shameless about raising your rates. your existing clients should know too.

shame has never once closed a deal.
comment: The challenge is balancing confidence with credibility. Selling becomes easier when your proof, process, and outcomes are clear—shameless promotion works best when backed by consistent delivery.
